queries.Garmin-Health-Overview.json:16:A: WITH daily AS (SELECT COALESCE(local_date, (time AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date) AS day, avg(health_number(fields, 'stressLevel')) FILTER (WHERE health_number(fields, 'stressLevel') >= 0) AS value FROM all_records WHERE dataset = 'StressIntraday' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND time >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '37 days' AND time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz + interval '2 days' GROUP BY 1), days AS (SELECT generate_series(($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date - 35, ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date, interval '1 day')::date AS day), series AS (SELECT day, value, CASE WHEN count(value) OVER w7 >= 3 THEN avg(value) OVER w7 END AS avg7, avg(value) OVER w28 AS base, greatest(coalesce(stddev_samp(value) OVER w28, 0), 2) AS spread, count(value) OVER w28 AS n FROM days LEFT JOIN daily USING (day) WINDOW w7 AS (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w28 AS (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 28 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)) SELECT day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring} AS time, value AS "Average stress", avg7 AS "7-day average", CASE WHEN n >= 14 THEN base + spread END AS "Usual range", CASE WHEN n >= 14 THEN base - spread END AS "Usual low" FROM series WHERE day >= ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date ORDER BY 1
